records.subject: Welcome aboard, Maple Works
records.body:

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project set up
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Following up on my welcome note last week. Nothing's moved in Wrenfield yet, which is completely normal when a team is still working out of docs and chat threads.

The simplest place to start: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project with a few tasks is usually enough to see whether this fits how Maple Works works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
